hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: At each step t >= 1, the first t * k characters have been dropped, leaving the suffix word[t * k:].

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: If this suffix matches the prefix of word of the same length, we can choose the appended characters to restore the original word.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate t from 1 to ceil(n / k) and check if word[t * k:] == word[:n - t * k].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct suffix-prefix slice comparisons for n <= 50.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full string BFS state generation is unnecessary since only valid matching suffixes matter.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that any characters can be appended, so only matching remaining suffix is required.
